annotations.title: Remove an uploaded file from a server

description: Uninstalls a custom mod, plugin or datapack file that was uploaded to the server and deletes the file, taking effect at the next restart. The file can only be recovered from a backup.

fileName.description: Installed file name, as listed in the server's uploaded content.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: deleteAsset
